title: Optional Coverage Add-Ons Visit Fee Basis by Trade
content:
The rider visit fee basis for an Optional Coverage Add-Ons rider service request follows the trade of the request, compared with two figures of the base Homeowner Service Contracts contract: the service call fee elected on that contract, and the base tier's standard service call fee.

| Trade of the rider request | Elected fee compared with the tier's standard service call fee | Rider visit fee basis |
|---|---|---|
| A trade the base homeowner plan services itself: hvac, plumbing, electrical or appliance | At or below the standard fee | The elected fee |
| A trade the base homeowner plan services itself: hvac, plumbing, electrical or appliance | Above the standard fee | The lower of the two, which is the standard fee |
| A trade only riders service: pool and spa, septic, well pump or roofing | Any | The higher of the elected fee and the standard fee |

## Hypothetical figures

Elected fee USD 90.00, tier standard service call fee USD 110.00 (both hypothetical):

- an appliance-trade request: basis USD 90.00;
- a septic-trade request: basis USD 110.00.

Elected fee USD 150.00, tier standard service call fee USD 110.00 (both hypothetical):

- an electrical-trade request: basis USD 110.00;
- a roofing-trade request: basis USD 150.00.
